shortDescription: Promote a node as the primary node

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname of the primary node.

options.name: ip
options.description: The public IP address of the primary node

options.name: ise_verify
options.description: Whether or not to verify the identity of the node.

options.name: ise_version
options.description: The version of the ISE node.

options.name: ise_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: Whether or not to wait on rate limit

options.name: password
options.description: The password to log into the primary node.

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles to be fulfilled by this node. Must contain at least PPAN and any of MNT-ACTIVE or MNT-STANDBY or PDP

options.name: username
options.description: The username to log into the primary node.
